title: Chapter 123 Leaked Whereabouts
content:
Chapter 123 Leaked Whereabouts

Now, hearing that His Majesty the Emperor was able to defeat those gods who made it difficult for them to resist, the soldiers couldn't help but feel a burst of horror and fear.

They couldn't help but recall why they left their original world and came to this world. The scene of the world collapsing, the world dying, and everything returning to ruins once again emerged in their hearts.

For a while, everyone in Sun Jian's camp lost their morale, and no one said they were going to attack Pingyin City in front of them.

Because they understand, even if it is defeated. Under the pressure of His Majesty the Emperor, the 100,000 army, there is no resistance at all.

At the same time, those in the army who do not want to die. Inevitably, other thoughts arose in my heart, and I kept peeping at Sun Jian and others with malicious eyes hidden in the dark.

The spying and malice of these people made people like Sun Jian in the camp stand upright, as if they were sitting on pins and needles, and they didn't want to stay in this camp for a moment.

He wished he could take some people away now, leave this plain, he would not believe that the world is so big, could this emperor really be able to cover the sky with one hand? Leave yourself without a place to hide.

However, he knew that he couldn't leave, so he left the army and walked with his confidantes of more than a hundred people. In this extraordinary and dangerous place, there is no place for self-protection at all.

Therefore, I can only suffer here, waiting for my final destiny to arrive. At the same time, regret inevitably arose in my heart, hating myself for being so smug at the beginning and doing such foolish things.

However, Sun Jian wanted to accept his fate, but his son, Sun Ce and others were unwilling.

Sun Ce, who was only fifteen or sixteen years old at this time, was at the age of youth and full of vigor and hope for everything, so how could he easily accept his fate? Give up the mastery of your own life to others!

Therefore, Sun Ce, who understands that things cannot be done, can no longer control all the troops in the entire barracks. Directly recruited some confidantes.

In a secret tent, after discussing with his confidants, Sun Ce contacted some generals under Sun Jian's command and told them about the current situation.

Tell them clearly that at this moment we have no way out, and if we can't win the fight now, we can only run away.

After getting the unanimous consent of all the generals, they went back to summon their confidants, and Sun Ce knocked Sun Jian unconscious. The next morning, when all the soldiers got up, they were wondering why there were no generals today, so they came to get them up early?

When I went to the commander's tent to have a look, I found that all the generals had run over, and there was not a single leader left. After everyone's discussion, they decided to surrender.

In this way, the remaining 10,000 soldiers under General Sun surrendered like Tian Feng and others in Pingyin City.

When Tian Feng and others saw groups of soldiers surrounding the city, they thought that Sun Jian was coming to attack the city again. Unexpectedly, those soldiers all threw down their weapons, surrendered on their knees, and wanted to return to Yuguo's command again.

Overjoyed, Tian Feng and others sent people to investigate first, and found that it was indeed not a disguise, so they happily accepted the return of this group of soldiers.

Then he quickly sent a messenger to report to Zhong Yu, and waited for Zhong Yu's next order and instruction. When Zhong Yu received the order, it was already an afternoon. At this moment, Sun Jian and others had already fled far away, and it was difficult to find them.

Therefore, Zhong Yu could only let them go with hatred, and slowly settle accounts with them after thinking about it. Then he ordered Tian Feng and Zhang Liao to lead more than 1,000 soldiers in the city and more than 10,000 surrendered troops, and continue to march towards the southwest region.

These more than 10,000 people are just the vanguard. Zhong Yu intends to lead an army of 100,000 to conquer the southwestern region.

Three days later, when Tian Feng and the others approached the city of Vogo again, they already knew that their lives had fallen, and those yellow-skinned enemy troops came under pressure again. With their own tribe, the clan chief Wolf was absolutely irresistible.

Send messengers directly to contact Tian Feng and others, hoping to accept their surrender and not implicate the lives of the tribesmen in their tribe.

After Tian Feng received the order, he didn't dare to make a decision, so he sent a messenger to inform Zhong Yu, and Zhong Yu was preparing to go out at this moment, when he suddenly received this request to surrender.

After pondering for a while, I ordered and accepted.

The reason why they accepted their request was because they had just received a notification from the system.

Because of the death of the god Rui En, the Heavenly Dao and other gods in this world already knew about the existence of Zhong Yu, but they hadn't been able to find out yet. What exactly is Zhong Yu's strength?

For the time being, he was a bit cautious and didn't dare to act immediately, but now he is sending people to investigate. With the current ability of the system, it can only help Zhong Yu cover him up for three months. Three months later, Tiandao must have discovered that Zhong Yu had nowhere to escape at that time.

Therefore, the system told Zhong Yu to collect as many luck points as possible in these three months, and then prepare to run away with the system, leave this world first, and go to other worlds!

So Zhong Yu thinks that at this moment, since he can no longer regard this world as his base. Then, just like the Three Kingdoms, a kind of oppressive rule is carried out.

First obtain the nominal dominant position, and then gather many creatures under his command, and then sacrifice them with blood at one time, so that he can gain a huge amount of luck points.

What's more, when he got the news that he had been discovered by this different world, the gods of heaven, Zhong Yu immediately asked the system, can he sacrifice this world to the part he ruled?

As a result, the system said that he has a formation map here, and by arranging him on this plain, using the blood sacrifices of the living beings on the entire plain, he can temporarily separate this plain from the heavenly connection of this world.

At that time, the system can directly crack this plain and pull it out of the heaven of this world. And Zhong Yu can also pay the price of luck points to directly form this split plain into his own small world.

Entrust the world inside the system itself, so that Zhong Yu will at least have a place to hide in every world in the future, no matter what kind of situation he encounters.

Hearing this news, Zhong Yu was overjoyed, isn't this exactly what he needs?

With this world, then I can start my own heaven plan ahead of schedule. Go to various worlds to conquer, bring them into the small world under his own heaven, and then carry out the ascension system from his world.

All the highest powerhouses in the world ascend level by level, and then the ultimate goal of ascension is their own heaven, so that they will never lack talents and soldiers who can recruit and fight well.

But I asked the system, how much luck is needed to do this? The amount he got made him feel as frustrated as an eggplant beaten by frost.

With 8 million luck points, he only got 10 million by killing those gods himself. It really hurt him to take so much at once.

But thinking of the benefits of owning a world made him make up his mind that he must do this.
